name: Columns™
description:
Drift back in time to a bygone
civilisation, the ancient world of
Phoenicia. Play a game that
originated among the Phoenician
merchants. It's incredibly captivating,
yet easy to pick up. You'll find
yourself losing track of time!
disclaimer: You may need an additional compatible SD card or SDHC card with available space to download this software. Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
